title: Bless TV Anime's 1st Full Promo Video Announces January 8 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga presented the first full promotional video and a key visual on Saturday. The video announces that the anime will premiere on January 8. It also previews the ending theme song "New Page" by HIKKA .

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

The anime will star:

• Tomohiro Ōno as Aia Udagawa

• Chiyuki Miura as Jun Sumisaki

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Ginga Yoyogi

• Yoshino Aoyama as Oroka Sumeragi

• Momoka Terasawa as Shitataka Sumeragi

• Kentarō Kumagai as MM

• Yoshiki Nakajima as Joe Osaki

• Kōki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano

• Tarusuke Shingaki as Hikaru Oya

Shōtarō Kitamura ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! ) is directing the anime at A-1 Pictures , and Takayuki Kikuchi (episode director for Solo Leveling , Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is the assistant director. Fukurou Kamiza ( Non Non Biyori Nonstop ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Honoka Yokoyama ( Oshi no Ko TV 2 , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is both the character designer and chief animation director, and Tetsuya Kawakami ( A Certain Magical Index , Sword Art Online ) and Reina Iwasaki ( VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream ) are also chief animation directors. Ryō Yoshimata ( Somali and the Forest Spirit , After the Rain ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Costume Design: Akane Takeda (A-1 Pictures)

• Prop Design: Takayuki Kidou

• Main Animators: Yūichirō Iida, Marina Kobayashi, Mirai Harashima (A-1 Pictures)

• Hair and Makeup Supervisor: Katsuyoshi Kojima (tron)

• Graphic Illustration: Kashimaki

• Color Design: Mana Hokuto (A-1 Pictures)

• Art Director: Risa Wakabayashi (A-1 Pictures)

• Background Art: Kiya Hirayoshi (A-1 Pictures)

• CG Director: Yuki Kuribayashi

• Director of Photography: Hideki Eto (EXPLOSION)

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Kōhei Yoshida

• Sound Effects: Takuya Hasegawa

Crunchyroll will stream the series worldwide excluding Japan and China when it debuts in January.

Sonoyama debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha published the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.

Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga's seventh volume on February 10. Kodansha is also releasing the manga digitally on its K MANGA service.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action series that Amazon Prime Video will stream worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: 'There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her' Anime Gets 2nd Season
content:
The staff for the television anime of Suisei 's Yūsha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Itanode, Kokuhaku Shite Mita ( There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her ) light novel series and Kairi 's manga adaptation announced on Saturday that production on a second season has been green-lit. The main cast will reprise their roles in the new season.

The series stars:

• Kōhei Amasaki as Yōki

• Kana Hanazawa as Cecilia

• Ryōhei Kimura as Yūga

• Yūko Natsuyoshi as Mikana

• Toshiki Masuda as Duke

• Minami Tanaka as Seek

• Iori Noguchi as Happiness

• Ayumu Murase as Raven

Kairi 's manga adaptation is what is credited for the original work.

Yasutaka Yamamoto ( Medalist, Servant × Service ) is the chief director, and Tomonori Mine ( Isekai Onsen Paradise ) is directing the series at Gekkō . Yukie Sugawara ( Overlord, No Guns Life ) is both writing and overseeing the series scripts. Mina Ōsawa ( The Strongest Sage With the Weakest Crest , Reincarnated as the Daughter of the Legendary Hero and the Queen of Spirits ) is adapting illustrator La-na 's character designs for animation. Satoru Kōsaki ( BEASTARS , The Apothecary Diaries ) and MONACA are composing the music. Ryō Aizawa is the producer at Starry Cube .

The anime premiered on January 6 at 11:00 p.m. JST on Tokyo MX , and also aired on HBC , RKB Mainichi Broadcasting , AT-X , and BS11 . Crunchyroll streamed the anime worldwide excluding Asia but including India and the Indian Subcontinent.

Suisei launched the series on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Become Novelists) website in 2013. Futabasha began publishing the manga in print with illustrations by La-na in October 2014, and published the third volume in August 2015.

Kairi launched the manga adaptation on Futabasha 's Gaugau Monster website in 2021.

title: 'Yuusha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Ita node, Kokuhaku shitemita.' Second Season in Production
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Suisei and Kairi ’s Yuusha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Ita node, Kokuhaku shitemita. ( There was a Cute Girl in the Hero’s Party, so I Tried Confessing to Her. ) manga announced a second season on Saturday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured).

Produced by Gekkou , the first season aired in 13-episodes in Winter 2026. Crunchyroll simulcasted the anime with subtitle in multiple languages.

Kairi began serializing the manga adaptation of Suisei’s romantic adventure novel in Manga Gaugau in January 2021. The 14th volume was released on July 15.

Suisei originally began writing the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in July 2013. Futabasha began publishing the light novel under its Monster Bunko imprint with illustrations by La-na ( Majutsushi Kunon wa Mieteiru ) in October 2024. The third and final volume went on sale in August 2015.

NTT Docomo publishes the manga digitally in English on its Manga Mirai web service on February 25.

title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Anime's New Teaser Unveils More Cast, Ending Song
content:
The official website for the television anime of Kashiko Amane 's Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret ( Hōkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru ) manga presented a new teaser promotional video on Saturday. The video announces three more cast members from the idol group ≒JOY, and it also announces and previews the ending theme song "Naritai Watashi" (The Me I Want To Be) by the in-story idol group Indigo Impulse.

The newly announced cast members are:

Renon Esumi as Saitō

Aoi Ōnishi as Okaba

Yen Press publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there's one silver lining, he's not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!

The anime's cast members include:

Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno

Hikaru Tōno as Rei Kuromiya

=LOVE idol group member Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai

Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno

Hikaru Sato ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You , Dropkick on My Devil! ) is directing the anime at Gekkō , and Fumihiko Shimo ( BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. , Full Metal Panic! , Infinite Stratos ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. Kibidango 14-gō ( Azuma Tozawa , Wash It All Away ) is designing the characters. Satoru Kōsaki ( The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya , Monogatari Series, Aharen-san wa Hakarenai ) and monaca ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai , Star Driver , Wake Up, Girls! ) are composing the music. Ryō Aizawa ( Starry Cube ) is producing.

The anime will premiere in April 2027. Crunchyroll will stream the anime as it airs in Japan.

Amane has been serializing the manga on Hakusensha 's Young Animal Web site since September 2022, and Hakusensha published the ninth volume this past July. Yen Press published the fourth manga volume in June.

title: Abema Selects Project PRISMation's 1st Open Call Finalists to Make 3 Pilot Anime
content:
The Japanese streaming service ABEMA announced the three finalists from the first open call in its " Project PRISMation " for independent animators on Friday. The three selected entries will each receive production funding for a short original anime pilot slated for next year or later.

The three selected entries are:

"OXY-HEAVEN"

Synopsis: Eden, a colossal ship-nation, is booming with postwar reconstruction. In a quiet corner stands the cafe OXY HEAVEN, where a former doctor turned proprietor mends the hearts of wounded souls with a cup of coffee and a healthy dose of meddling. A fantasy ensemble drama set in a steampunk world.

ABEMA describes creator Waboku as an "animation artist and illustrator. Known for a distinctive directorial style built on decadent, atmospheric worlds and a keen sense of timing. Has directed numerous music videos, including Eve's 'As You Like It' and ZUTOMAYO 's 'Byoushin wo Kamu.'"

"Amneka"

Synopsis: In a small school far from anywhere, six students and one teacher live together. Amneka, a young girl, tries to live peacefully alongside her colorful classmates, but a secret she herself does not know begins to quietly unsettle their everyday life. A fantasy comedy set in a small school.

ABEMA describes creator orange as "an up-and-coming filmmaker. Grew up watching and falling in love with short animation, and came to want to make works of their own. Enjoys taking walks and riding buses and trains when they are nearly empty. Aims to create work that holds on to the small ideas that surface in everyday life and the sensations that are hard to forget."

"Kandy-Killers for Hire"

Synopsis: In an absurd neon city where murder has become a commercial industry, Kandie runs a scrappy assassination startup. When the corporate murder conglomerate ASASU pushes her business to the brink of bankruptcy, she ropes in her best friends Poppy and Gumi for a desperate, blood-soaked marketing campaign. A psycho-pop dark comedy.

ABEMA describes creator Dominique Garrow as "a freelance illustrator from the United States with a deep passion for the cute, the creepy, and the crazy! Inspired by anime and manga from early childhood, she has since become an independent illustrator and animator, creating works within the VTuber community across various platforms. Beginning production as a fourth-year high school student, she strives to improve every single day. She hopes to combine her experiences as an internet artist, film student, and lover of all things moe to begin building memorable, imaginative worlds of her own."

ABEMA held the open call from this past May to August. In addition to producing each anime pilot, ABEMA "will support each work on its way to audiences worldwide, from project development, Japanese and English voice casting, sound and music arrangements, and translation to promotion and commercial development."

Project PRISMation is a collaboration with various creators, primarily individuals or small teams who produce web animation, to create original anime pilot films. The name Prismation comes from "Prism" and "Animation," and it "symbolizes a space where diverse talents converge to shine brightly."

The project released the " Poppin-Play Kitchen " pilot on January 16, and currently it has 2.5 million views. The " Project PRISMation " also released the " Gluttomy " pilot work by rapitus from Vietnam on January 23, and " The Horrors' Horror Home " pilot by creator Uguisu Kobo , director Rushio Moriyama , and writer Yūya Matsuzaki from Japan on January 30.

The project also announced its second round of pilots on September 19. It plans to release the pilots for Miou Hiruma's "The Chatty Jewel and the Phantom Thieves," Yū Satō's "SALON de MONDE," and Fantasy Restaurant Kani's 'LAMPMOSS COFFEE" next month.

title: A Tsujita Artisan Noodle X Umamusume Collab Starts November 12
content:
Tsujita Artisan Noodle has announced a collaboration with the Umamusume: Pretty Derby franchise. The Tsujita Artisan Noodle x Umamusume collab runs from November 12 to December 20 at the restaurant’s Houston, Fort Lee, and Downtown Los Angeles locations. Participating restaurants will offer anime-inspired menu items, limited-edition merchandise, and free goodies.

Tsujita Artisan Noodle x Umamusume merchandise will be available. Merch will be limited to two items per person and only available in store. Customers will receive a free coaster.

The event’s menu includes:

• Cheerful Carrot & Strawberry Float — A sweet drink made with strawberry ice cream, carrots, and mango, topped with strawberry jam and a carrot-shaped ribbon. Its colors give a nod to Haru Urara.

• Sweet & Spicy Purple Bun Set — Home-style pork chashu and fried chicken buns topped with cabbage slaw. The dish honors Rice Shower, who prefers bread over rice for breakfast.

• Upside-Down Fried Chicken Bowl — Made for Umamusume‘s mighty eater, Oguri Cap, this bowl features home-style fried chicken, sweet corn, green onions, and savory sauce over an extra-large serving of rice.

• Golden Spicy Cheese Miso Ramen (available November 12 to 30) — A spicy miso ramen honoring Special Week and her Hokkaido roots. It’s topped with a carrot-shaped garnish, pork chashu, grilled corn, seasoned egg, melted cheese, and menma (fermented bamboo).

• Majestic Cajun Seafood Tsukemen (available December 1 to 20) — A Cajun-style seafood and pork broth with mussels, shrimp, corn, sausage, bell peppers, lime, and spices. It honors Fine Motion, Umamusume‘s notorious ramen lover.

The Tsujita Artisan Noodle x Umamusume collab is the restaurant’s latest anime collaboration. Previous collaborations have featured Genshin Impact , Captain Tsubasa , and BLEACH .

Umamusume: Pretty Derby is a multimedia franchise by Cygames, Inc . The franchise features characters based on real-world racehorses.

title: Mixed Media Project 'Harajuku Himegoto House' Announces TV Anime Adaptation
content:
Entertainment company Plott announced a television anime adaptation of its Harajuku Himegoto House mixed-media project on Saturday, revealing the main cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video.

Cast Mizuki Otokozawa: Yuuya Hirose ( Mato Seihei no Slave ) Mero Togariishi: Tetsuei Sumiya ( Fairy Ranmaru ) Takara Rokurokusou: Souhei Horikane ( Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku ) Kentarou Jinbayama: Masaru Yoshimura Yuki Inubou: Takuma Nagatsuka ( SK∞ ) Hitoshi Haritsukekawara: Nobuhiko Okamoto ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Shou Dogenzaka: Shoutarou Morikubo ( Naruto )

Staff Planning, Production: Plott Music: Bandai Namco Music Live ( Lantis ) Promotional Cooperation: animate Original Character Design: Akane Aki ( Paradox Live the Animation )

The project was first teased on August 3 before being officially launched by Plott as a mixed-media project. It includes music releases and live events as part of its development, with an exclusive voice drama featuring the main cast made available at Animate Girls Festival 2026.

title: 3 Years Ago, Attack on Titan Finale Proved Why It Remains a Modern Classic
content:
When it comes to modern anime, specifically those released in the 2010s and 2020s, Attack on Titan’s legacy can’t be matched with anything else. Written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the manga reached its controversial finale in 2021, which sparked so much fury from fans that the creator was losing sleep over it. However, the controversy didn’t last for long when MAPPA took over the anime series for the final season. Although WIT Studio worked on the first three seasons of the anime, it faced difficulty meeting the tight deadlines since the manga was already over. It didn’t take long for MAPPA to take over the helm, and that probably saved the franchise’s legacy.

Established in 2011, MAPPA is known as one of the most renowned animation studios in Japan. While its popularity skyrocketed in the 2020s with the release of Jujutsu Kaisen and a few other acclaimed shows, the studio had a strong foundation with exceptional shows and movies under its belt ever since its establishment. Fans naturally had high expectations from the studio for the final season, especially since the time-skip changed the entire narrative. MAPPA not only lived up to the expectations, but delivered the best possible version of the story in the final season and special episodes. The anime reached its conclusion on November 4th, 2023, with the release of the second special episode of Attack on Titan: Final Season – The Final Chapters.

MAPPA Saved Attack on Titan ‘s Legacy With Exceptional Adaptation

While WIT Studio laid down the foundation of the story with the first three seasons, MAPPA wrapped up the anime with the best possible version. Considering how much fans hated the finale when the manga was being serialized, not many expected that the controversy would completely die down after the anime adaptation. Isayama contributed to

Unlike what one might expect, the change in studio wasn’t a major issue and did nothing to change fans’ enjoyment of the series. WIT Studio laid the foundation of the incredible story within the first three seasons. The fluid movements through the ODM gears and the cinematic sequences are still praised among fans. The color composition fit the mood of the story incredibly as it follows Eren’s journey. However, when it comes to MAPPA’s adaptation, it leans more towards darker shading and gritty details that are closer to the manga.

Many fans preferred the original art style more while also complimenting MAPPA’s adaptation, especially considering the short deadline. Season 3 was a roller coaster of emotions, and while WIT Studio couldn’t have adapted the entire story, it plays a huge role in the franchise’s current legacy. Following the time-skip, the story changed completely as Eren saw the truth of the world through the powers of the Founding Titan. He set his plan in motion and did everything he could to save Eldia, even if it came at the cost of stomping on 80% of the world’s population.

Do you think MAPPA delivered the perfect ending for Attack on Titan ? What moment from the finale made the biggest impression on you? Share your thoughts in the comments below!

title: Netflix’s Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is Officially a Hit With Millions of Views
content:
A new report confirms that Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 is one of the biggest hits of the year, not just on Netflix but among most of the anime released this year. The highly anticipated anime sequel was released last month after making fans wait for four years. Thanks to the hype of the series, the sequel also became a massive hit as the anime returns with ten episodes, just like the first season. Considering the first season’s popularity, it’s no surprise that the sequel was also a massive hit, even if it follows an entirely new set of characters instead of continuing the beloved story of David Martinez and Lucy.

Netflix Tudum reveals that the anime gathered more than 4.6 million views between October 19th and 25th, which was during the first week of the anime’s release. Since the week started on October 19th, the number of views mentioned here was from the first six days of the release. It also ranked third among the top 10 global non-English shows, which again proves how much the franchise is loved even after all these years. The anime sequel released all episodes at once , and since most of the fans have already watched it, the second season didn’t rank in the top 10 chart in the following week.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Follows a New Story

After a successful first season, the anime continues to explore the animated world of Night City. The sequel also helped the series flesh out the world-building that first started with CD Projekt Red’s video game, Cyberpunk 2077 . While the first season had a fairly conclusive ending, fans followed the story head towards a new direction with new characters. Instead of centering around an aspiring Edgerunner like David, the second season focuses on a character named Weak Kingsley. Weak is a past-his-prime veteran Edgerunner, who has long since become a legend of Night City. However, he is now mostly living without the technology that brought him to the top of the food chain. After a series of unexpected events, he finds himself dragged back into the world he once left behind.

Will There Be a Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 3?

So far, a sequel season hasn’t been officially confirmed yet , but fans can still expect an update in the next few years. The first season was released in 2022, and it took the anime three years to officially confirm a sequel. While the second season was announced in July 2025, it made its debut in October this year. Just like the first season, it wraps up the story of the protagonist. During the finale, Weak removed and downgraded all of his implants after nearly succumbing to cyberpsychosis, effectively ending his days as a legendary edgerunner. As the story ends, he drives away from Night City, along with Talia, as they both leave behind the corporate dystopia to help her find peace. This means that if the anime were to return with a third season, it would feature another story again centering around new characters, their struggles, and their journey.

title: 25 Years Later, Cowboy Bebop Director Breaks Silence on the Biggest Challenge With the Anime
content:
It’s been 25 years since the anime was released, but Shinichirō Watanabe’s Cowboy Bebop is still among one of the most popular shows of all time. The anime is commemorating a major milestone this year, which again brings the director into the spotlight as he shares updates on the upcoming 4K remastered version. Cowboy Bebop may be his most popular work, but Watanabe is known for directing several acclaimed shows over the decades , including Samurai Champloo, Kids on the Slope, Space Dandy , and many more. His latest project is Lazarus , which was released in 2024, but failed to get the response it deserved.

While the legendary director hasn’t shared any updates on his upcoming project, Cowboy Bebop is getting a major revival this year. Following the release of Lazarus , many wondered if the director would return with a sequel to the anime, but that’s not the case anymore. His next project will be something entirely new, although it’s uncertain when it will be announced. So far, the director hasn’t confirmed working on a new project, but fans are eagerly awaiting his return with another exciting story. During a recent interview, he talked about the anime’s latest project, which has been released only in Japan.

Cowboy Bebop Director Opens Up About the Biggest Challenge He Faced With the Anime

Animate Times shared the interview from the advanced screening of the latest 4K remastered movie, where Shinichiro Watanabe and composer Yoko Kanno were in attendance. He discussed the difficulties of preparing the 4K movie version of the series. Watanabe shared, “When you make an analog-era film high-definition, there are risks. (Because many cels are layered) in some works, the amount of cel dust becomes very noticeable. This work in particular has a lot of layered cels, so there was a risk that scratches and shadows would be visible, but Bandai Namco Filmworks and the post-production team did an incredible job, spending months manually erasing each frame and finishing it to a magnificent quality. I just said, ‘Erase it all, thanks to you,’ and left (laughs).”

This is the biggest risk he faced with the anime in 25 years, especially since the movie not only had to retain the beauty of the original but also provide fans with a much better quality than they are used to. The 90s animation style is loved for its grainy visuals and a color palette unique to that era, which hasn’t been replicated in recent years. This is all the more reason why Cowboy Bebop ‘s anniversary project couldn’t lose the charm of the original. The movie had to make a concise version of the TV show, but the biggest problem was avoiding the risk of getting shadows and scratches while working on the remaster. Bandai Namco Filmworks avoided the use of AI and did everything manually over the course of several months, which is why Watanabe is more than satisfied with the final result.

When Is Cowboy Bebop ‘s 4K Remastered Movie Coming to the U.S.?

The new movie, Cowboy Bebop: Knockin’ on Heaven’s Door , was released as an anniversary project in Japan. The movie is currently showing in Japanese theatres with no information on a U.S. release. The movie’s trailer features gorgeous visuals that international fans aren’t used to. However, so far, there have been no updates from Bandai Namco Filmworks on whether the movie will have a theatrical release in the U.S. first or if it will only get a Blu-ray DVD release. Cowboy Bebop maintains a huge fan base across the world , especially in the West, which is why there’s reason to believe the movie will eventually land in U.S. theatres, although there’s no telling how long fans will have to wait.
